newsitem.title: USA: Prime Retail plans Missouri shopping mall.
newsitem.headline: Prime Retail plans Missouri shopping mall.

text.p: Prime Retail Inc. said Wednesday it has an agreement with Sansone Group to develop a 700,000 square-foot, $70 million indoor shopping mall in Eureka, Missouri, a suburb of St. Louis.

The mall, to be built on 113 acres, is expected to open in early 1999 and include outlet stores, superstore chains, a large multi-screen movie theater and restaurants. It is expected to create up to 500 construction jobs and 1,000 to 1,500 permanent jobs once it opens, Prime Retail said.

Prime Retail, based in Baltimore, said that as general partner and majority owner, it will arrange construction financing and provide the required equity capital. After receiving a preferred return on its equity investment, Prime Retail will receive 75 percent of the profits from the project, with the remaining 25 percent going to Sansone.
Prime Retail is a real estate investment trust that develops and manages factory outlet centers.
Privately-held Sansone Group develops shopping centers, office buildings and industrial parks in the Midwest.
